description: A mushroom with a wide domed cap bearing a large circular spot at the top centre and two half-spots at its sides, over a short rounded stalk with two upright oval eyes.
A mushroom with a broad domed cap marked by one large circular spot at the centre, sitting over a short rounded stalk with two upright oval eyes.
A round sun-like face with two upright oval eyes, surrounded by eight evenly spaced straight rays pointing out on the vertical, horizontal and diagonal axes.
A tree trunk with a face — two eyes and a small heart-shaped mouth — a jagged top, two branch arms raised up and out to both sides, and roots flaring left and right at the base.
A turtle walking right: a domed shell covering its body with a flat rim, a raised head on a curved neck at the right with a large eye, and two stubby feet below the shell.

A small dinosaur facing right in a running pose: a large rounded head with a bulbous snout at the top right, a crest along the back, a saddle curve at the left and two bent legs; the reference is hard to read.
A front-facing round face under a domed cap with a brim line across the forehead, two ears at the sides, two upright oval eyes and a wide smile.
A front-facing face with closed eyes and small lips, crowned and framed by writhing snakes whose curling bodies spread out above and on both sides; the reference is dense and hard to read.
An armoured figure from the front: a helmet with a tall pointed V crest and spiky side fins, a small face with two eyes, and blocky shoulder armour spreading out at the lower left and right.
A round helmet with a tall rounded fin rising from the top centre and two ear pods on its sides, framing a face opening with an M-shaped brow edge and two eyes.
An upright oval potato head with a small hat on top, two protruding ears, big round eyes, a large wedge nose and a wide grinning mouth.
A muscular hero from the front: two tall V-shaped hair spikes rising from the head, deep-set shadowed eyes, a broad jaw, and wide bulging shoulders and arms.
A front-facing head with a crown of spiky hair along the top, a forehead protector band carrying a spiral leaf symbol, closed smiling eyes, a smile and two ears.
Two rounded Joy-Con halves side by side with a narrow gap: the left with a stick dot above a plus-shaped D-pad, the right with a single large round button, their outer edges rounded.
